purpose.role: Multi-agent coherence context: tracks dimensional role assignment and coherence quality across agent pantheons
purpose.description: Pantheons defines multi-agent diagnostic contexts within TriadicFrameworks. A pantheon is a registered set of agents (human, AI, or hybrid) each assigned to specific dimensional roles within an S3 Spine run. The Pantheons module tracks inter-agent coherence, role conflicts, dimensional coverage gaps, and signal redundancy across the pantheon. It feeds coherence quality signals to the Coherence Overlay and role-assignment metadata to the Domain Overlay for pantheon-specific DDR framing.
